rationale: Previous full studies restored old blouse pixels because coarse source hair overlapped the editable garment. Lower ambiguous-hair fallback threshold from 25 to 10 percent; retain raw when ambiguous. Keep new coat dress-class silhouette and legitimate arm occlusion.
gate: All 40 matched fixed outputs independently reviewed; exact-source pixel protection reduces changed pixels outside accepted editable regions. No identity/body/background or garment/edge score regressions versus validated raw baseline; at least32/40 and8/10 each category. Raw fallback remains for ambiguous/absent regions. Pixel metrics alone do not establish quality.
